newsitem.title: USA: CNS Inc Q4 net affected by tax differences.
newsitem.headline: CNS Inc Q4 net affected by tax differences.

text.p: CNS Inc said Monday tax differences between 1995 and 1996 had a considerable effect on its net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company reported net income of $5.5 millionm compared to $2.9 million one year ago. CNS said pre-tax income totaled $8.2 in the most recent period, versus $1.5 million in 1995. Sales reached $24.6 million, versus $12 million a year ago.
CNS said the year-ago figure included tax loss carryforwards that added about $500,000 to net income in the fourth quarter of 1995. Those carryforwards were not available in 1996, CNS said.
CNS markets consumer products, including the Breathe Right nasal strip.
Its shares were down 3/8 Monday at 14-3/8.
